summary: Axsome Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce FDA approval of AUVELITY for Alzheimer's disease agitation. This is a regulatory milestone, not a special-situation corporate event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change occurred. The filing discloses no deal terms or shareholder-related actions. It is purely an operational update regarding product approval, warranting no special-situation classification.
